limitations: The result requires the smooth positive-density uniformly convex continuous quadratic-cost setting and sufficiently small \(\varepsilon\). The neighborhood is local in the direct-sum \(L^\infty\) norm; no global basin-entry or invariance theorem is claimed. The contemporaneous working paper titled Geometry and Convergence of Quadratically Regularized Optimal Transport II was cited by the source geometry paper but no public full text was located, so some overlap risk remains.
provenance: Scientific sources, proof evidence, reproducibility material, and dated review evidence are listed in the record and audit files.
record_title: Natural-scale strong concavity for quadratically regularized optimal transport
